name: Starsource Multitrade Limited
summary: Starsource Multitrade Limited presently conducts no significant business operations. The company's former activities were focused on the production of pharmaceutical goods and bulk drug ingredients. It was previously recognized as Chemo Pharma Laboratories Limited before its name was altered to Starsource Multitrade Limited in October 2025. Founded in 1942, the firm is based in Mumbai, India.
